text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquered the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Acknowledging Matikane 
Tannhauser, who remained determined to win 
next time despite defeat, she offered 
words of encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, anticipation built for a 
sister showdown against Biwa Hayahide. 
However, Biwa Hayahide's return to racing 
seems hopeless...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian made a conscious effort not 
to think about her sister's injury, trying 
instead to focus on the Japan Cup.
